_doc: Cross-volume SEAMS WIRED by digestive_vp_site (v0.11.0). Single source of truth (SSOT) for the physiological quantities that touch this package's digestive/metabolic organs but are OWNED by a sibling volume. Per the MASTER MAP ownership contract and the neuro<->mind PROJECT_BOUNDARY discipline, the wiring is CITATION/POINTER-ONLY: digestive records a VENDORED SNAPSHOT of each sibling-owned quantity (verified once at vendoring time against the sibling engine, with the exact source function named), CONSUMES that snapshot in the seam layer (repro/_seams/seam_wiring.py), and NEVER imports a sibling's code. Each package re-establishes its entire trusted state from its own single zip with the siblings ABSENT; the firewall is enforced by an architectural lock (zero sibling imports) exactly as mind enforces it neuro-side. The siblings are the SSOT for the OUT-seams they declare; digestive is the consumer. DOIs: circulatory concept 10.5281/zenodo.20754354 ; mind concept 10.5281/zenodo.20694404.
_grade_legend: [V] sibling-owned quantity with a cited DOI + the exact source function, vendored faithfully (verified against the sibling engine at vendoring time) and consumed here; [F] a forced architectural identity (the firewall: zero sibling imports, the metabolic state takes no felt/HPA input); [O] the digestive-side HANDLING that rests on the consumed delivery substrate but is itself unmodelled here (no lipid primitive; felt experience owned by mind), each with a stated obstacle in IRREPRODUCIBILITY_LEDGER.md.
